race.comment: WESTERN MISS (5) comes back in trip today on the quick turnaround, dropping to 1400m as she rises in grade. She's building an impressive record though and looks a very exciting filly on the rise. Can be handy from the outset and while this is tougher, she may be better than this grade. HEAVEN SPECIFIED (7) missed by 0.7L first-up in this grade when closing strongly over 1200m. Out in trip now looks a good move and he's a second-up winner in the past. Maps to get every opportunity today and with improvement expected, he'll be hard to hold out. DESERT ORA (6) made it four in a row last start at Bunbury and deserves a shot at this level. She continues to raise the bar and her last start win was very impressive at her first try over 1400m. Worth plenty of thought. PARTAY (3) bolted in last start when back to this trip and gets Chris Parnham on now. Can go back-to-back without surprising. MOONWALK (2) is in good form and can't be left out of calculations.
